title: Logos 26 opening: not mine to give seats at right/left
english: Twenty-sixth discourse. On the Zebedee request: “to sit at my right or left is not mine to give.”
Refusal of that gift is read without denying equality of power with the Father.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
